blurb: New Bridge Marina offers pontoon boat, fishing boat, canoe, kayak, and standup paddleboard rentals, including delivery to nearby lakes and ponds. The marina provides slip rentals, boat repair, storage, winterization, a boat ramp, and a gas dock. The Blue Canoe Cafe serves ice cream and coffee on site.
extraNote: Located on the Lebanon side of the Northeast Channel at the site of the former New Bridge Road bridge.
